title: Moonie Framework
description: **Moonie** is a lightweight reactive web microframework built from scratch to understand how modern frontend frameworks implement core concepts such as *reactivity, templating, routing,* and component-oriented development. It uses a custom `.mn` syntax and implements these abstractions at a lower level, resulting in a framework of approximately **5 KB gzipped**.
extendedDescription:
**Moonie** is a lightweight reactive web microframework built from scratch to explore the concepts and abstractions behind modern frontend frameworks. It implements *reactivity, templating, directives, routing,* and component-oriented development without relying on an existing framework.
The project uses a custom `.mn` file-based template syntax that combines JavaScript logic with declarative templates and reactive state. At approximately **5 KB gzipped**, Moonie is intentionally small and serves as an exploration of the underlying mechanisms that make reactive web applications possible.
imageAlt: A minimalist, highly polished UI dashboard for a modern coffee shop.
